units.literal: The Emperor had long heard that Tuan possessed the Way and arts; he summoned him to court and after more than a month released him to his former seclusion.

units.zh: 庚戌，殿前都指揮使張永德奏，敗濠州送糧軍二千人於下蔡，奪米船十餘艘。
units.en: On gengxu Zhang Yongde reported defeating two thousand Hao grain convoy troops at Xiacai and capturing over ten supply boats.
units.literal: On day gengxu, the Commander of the Palace Front Army Zhang Yongde memorialized that he had defeated two thousand grain-transport troops from Hao Prefecture at Xiacai and seized more than ten rice boats.

units.zh: 宰臣李穀以風痹請告十旬，三上表求解所任，不允。
units.en: Chief Minister Li Gu requested three months' leave for rheumatism and thrice asked to resign; the Emperor refused.
units.literal: The chief minister Li Gu requested leave for ten-day leave because of wind paralysis and three times submitted memorials asking to be relieved of his post; this was not granted.

units.zh: 十二月己未朔，以給事中張鑄為光祿卿，鑄訴以官名與祖諱同，尋改秘書監，判光祿寺事。
units.en: On the first day of the twelfth month Zhang Zhu was made Director of Imperial Banquets but pleaded that the title violated his ancestor's taboo; he was reassigned as Secretariat director overseeing the Banquets office.
units.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, day jiwei, the Supervising Secretary Zhang Zhu was made Director of the Imperial Banquets. Zhu pleaded that the office title shared a character with his ancestor's taboo name; he was soon changed to Director of the Secretariat and administered affairs of the Imperial Banquets directorate.

units.zh: 辛酉，以許州節度使韓通兼侍衛馬步軍都虞候。
units.en: On xinyou, Han Tong, military governor of Xu Prefecture, was also made chief commandant of the palace horse and foot armies.
units.literal: On day xinyou, Han Tong, military governor of Xu Prefecture, was made concurrent Chief Commandant of the Palace Horse and Foot Armies.

units.zh: 壬戌，以右領軍大將軍、權判三司張美領三司使。
units.en: On renxu Zhang Mei, acting head of the Three Departments, was appointed their commissioner.
units.literal: On day renxu, the General of the Right Army Guards and acting administrator of the Three Departments Zhang Mei was placed in charge as Commissioner of the Three Departments.

units.zh: 壬申，以滑州節度使兼殿前都指揮使、駙馬都尉張永德為殿前都點校。
units.en: On renshen Zhang Yongde, Huazhou governor and palace commander, was made overall inspector of the palace armies.
units.literal: On day renshen, the military governor of Huazhou, Commander of the Palace Front Army, and Commander of the Imperial Sons-in-Law Zhang Yongde was made overall inspector of the palace front army.

units.zh: 發陳、蔡、宋、亳、潁、曹、單等州丁夫城下蔡。
units.en: Laborers from Chen, Cai, Song, Bo, Ying, Cao, Shan, and neighboring prefectures were drafted to fortify Xiacai.
units.literal: Corvée laborers were mobilized from Chen, Cai, Song, Bo, Ying, Cao, Shan, and other prefectures to fortify Xiacai.

units.zh: 辛巳，故襄邑令劉居方贈右補闕，男士衡賜學究出身，獎廉吏也。
units.en: On xinsi the late magistrate Liu Jufang was posthumously made Right Supplementation Censor and Shi Heng was granted scholar status, rewarding honest officials.
units.literal: On day xinsi, the former magistrate of Xiangyi Liu Jufang was posthumously given the title of Right Supplementation Censor; the gentleman Shi Heng was granted the status of classical scholar graduate—to reward upright officials.

units.zh: 癸亥，詔兵部尚書張昭纂修太祖實錄及梁均王、唐清泰帝兩朝實錄。
units.en: On guihai Minister of War Zhang Zhao was ordered to compile the Veritable Records of Taizu and the records of the Liang and Tang Qingtai reigns.
units.literal: On day guihai, an edict ordered the Minister of War Zhang Zhao to compile and revise the Veritable Records of Taizu and the veritable records of the two reigns of the Liang Prince of Jun and Tang Emperor Qingtai.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》云：同修撰官委張昭定名奏請，至四年正月，張昭奏請國子祭酒尹拙、太子詹事劉溫叟同編修。）〉
units.en: (The Institutions of the Five Dynasties records that Zhang Zhao was to nominate co-compilers; in the first month of the fourth year he proposed Yin Zhuo and Liu Wensou join the project.)〉
units.literal: (The Institutions of the Five Dynasties states: Co-compilers were to be named by Zhang Zhao in a memorial. By the first month of the fourth year, Zhang Zhao memorialized requesting the Chancellor of the Directorate of Education Yin Zhuo and the Grand Mentor of the Crown Prince Liu Wensou to join in compilation.)〉

units.zh: 又詔曰：「史館所少書籍，宜令本館諸處求訪補填。
units.en: Another edict ordered: "The History Office should seek out missing books everywhere.
units.literal: Another edict stated: "Books lacking in the History Office should be sought and supplemented everywhere by that office.

units.zh: 如有收得書籍之家，並許進書人據部帙多少等第，各與恩澤，如是卷帙少者，量給資帛。
units.en: Households presenting books would receive rewards graded by the number of volumes; smaller donations would receive proportionate gifts of silk.
units.literal: If any household had obtained books, donors were permitted to present books according to the number of fascicles in graded ranks, each receiving favors; if fascicles were few, stipends in goods and silks were given in measure.

units.zh: 如館內已有之書，不在進納之限。
units.en: Duplicates of books already in the collection were not eligible for rewards.
units.literal: Books already held within the office were not within the limit for presentation.

units.zh: 仍委中書門下，於朝官內選差三十人，據見在書籍，各求真本校勘，署校官姓名，逐月具功課申報中書門下。」
units.en: The Secretariat was to select thirty court officials to collate existing texts, sign their work, and report monthly to the Secretariat."
units.literal: The Secretariat was further entrusted to select thirty men from among court officials, who according to existing books would each seek true texts for collation, sign the collators' names, and each month report their work achievements to the Secretariat."

units.zh: 戊子，淮南道招討使李重進奏，破淮賊二千人於塌山北。

candidatePacket.instructions: Review dates, event ownership, conversions, endpoint evidence, age reckoning, omitted life dates, and active-date hints. Read all Chinese units for omissions; English is not independent evidence. Do not re-extract names or mentions. For each item identify whose event is dated and justify each endpoint. Same mother does not imply same birth year. Later allusions are not personal activity. Research or record a blocker rather than invent precision. A report cannot approve with missing checks or unresolved research.
